引入 ComfyUI 的生活方式工作流程！ 🖼️🌟

准备好见证技术与室内设计的完美融合。

通过这个 ComfyUI 工作流程，您的室内设计梦想即将实现！

只需上传您房间的照片，选择建筑风格，或输入自定义提示，然后观看人工智能发挥其魔力，为您提供梦想公寓的视觉呈现。

以下是集成到此工作流程中的关键自定义节点：

TinyTerraNodes：

探索这些令人难以置信的节点，它们为工作流程带来组织和效率，确保您的创作过程保持清晰简洁。GitHub 链接

Comfy_ControlNet_预处理器：

这些预处理器负责分析您上传的图像，是将您的设计愿景变为现实的关键的第一步。他们仔细检查您的房间照片，提取重要信息以指导后续的人工智能转型。GitHub 链接

ControlNet 段模型：

ControlNet Seg 模型是 Living Style 工作流程的基石，因为它创建了房间的分割图。 🗺️🖌️

通过利用人工智能的力量，该模型会检查您上传的图像并对其进行智能分割，将您的房间分成不同的组件和区域。该分割图充当您进行设计转换的画布。

这一关键步骤可确保识别并考虑房间的每个元素，从而实现精确和定制的设计增强。

要更深入地了解 ControlNet Seg 模型，您可以探索其功能GitHub并下载模型抱脸.

Mile High 快速造型器：

该工具可以轻松地为您选择的样式创建匹配的正面和负面提示。 Styler 会自动为您执行此步骤。奇维泰链接

该工作流程与所有 SD 1.5 模型无缝集成，为您提供无限的设计可能性。

不要错过这个绝佳的机会，轻松打造您梦想的生活空间。

立即通过 ComfyUI 的生活风格工作流程拥抱室内设计的未来！ 🏠🚀

Introducing the Living Style Workflow with ComfyUI! 🖼️🌟

Get ready to witness the perfect fusion of technology and interior design.

With this ComfyUI workflow, your interior design dreams are about to come true!

Simply upload a photo of your room, choose an architectural style, or input a custom prompt, and watch as AI works its magic, providing you with a visual representation of your dream apartment.

Here are the key custom nodes integrated into this workflow:

TinyTerraNodes:

Explore these incredible nodes they bring organization and efficiency to the workflow, ensuring that your creative process remains clear and concise.GitHub Link

Comfy_ControlNet_preprocessors:

These preprocessors are responsible for analyzing the image you upload, serving as the critical first step in turning your design vision into reality. They carefully examine your room photo, extracting essential information that will guide the subsequent AI-powered transformations.GitHub Link

ControlNet Seg Model:

The ControlNet Seg Model is the cornerstone of the Living Style Workflow, as it creates a segmentation map of your room. 🗺️🖌️

By leveraging the power of AI, this model examines your uploaded image and intelligently segments it, breaking down your room into various components and areas. This segmentation map serves as the canvas upon which your design transformations will take place.

This critical step ensures that each element of your room is identified and accounted for, allowing for precise and tailored design enhancements.

To get a deeper understanding of the ControlNet Seg Model, you can explore its capabilities onGitHuband download the Model atHugging Face.

Mile High Prompt Styler:

This tool makes it easy to create matching positive and negative prompts for the style you have chosen. The Styler automates this step for you.Civitai Link

This workflow seamlessly integrates with all SD 1.5 models, offering you limitless design possibilities.

Don't miss out on this extraordinary opportunity to effortlessly create your dream living space.

Embrace the future of interior design with ComfyUI's Living Style Workflow today! 🏠🚀
